setup: CREATE FUNCTION trunc(datetime timestamp, format varchar) RETURNS date LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE AS $$ BEGIN RETURN date_trunc('month',datetime)::date; END $$
CREATE FUNCTION trunc(datetime timestamptz, format varchar) RETURNS date LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE AS $$ BEGIN RETURN trunc(datetime::timestamp,format); END $$
CREATE VIEW invoice_v AS SELECT amount,invoiced FROM invoices

checks.sql: SELECT sum(amount),trunc(invoiced,'MM') FROM invoice_v GROUP BY trunc(invoiced,'MM') ORDER BY trunc(invoiced,'MM')
SELECT trunc(invoiced,'MM') AS month FROM invoice_v WHERE false
SELECT trunc(invoiced,'MM')+1 AS following_day FROM invoice_v ORDER BY invoiced
